name: PATH 4300
title: Principles of Pathobiology
description: The body's response to chemical, physical, and microbial injuries including the functional and morphologic alterations in disease of the major organ systems.
requirement_description: PATH 2100 or PNB 2264-2265 or PNB 2274-2275 or an equivalent course in vertebrate anatomy and physiology; open to juniors or higher. Recommended preparation: PATH 3100 or equivalent course in histology or cell biology.
